name: Stefan Meier
bio:
Stefan's motorsport journey began dismantling and reassembling go-karts in his father's garage, fueled by a childhood obsession with racing. He honed his engineering skills at ETH Zurich before diving into Formula Student, where his innovative suspension designs caught the eye of a junior formula team. After several years progressing through the ranks, he transitioned into a technical director role, where he balances meticulous analysis with a knack for spotting unconventional solutions. Stefan is known for his methodical approach and ability to extract maximum performance from limited resources, favoring data-driven decisions over gut feelings. He is a relentless problem-solver, always seeking to optimize every detail of the car's performance.

Stefan's pragmatic approach makes him unflappable under pressure; he remains calm and focused even when facing daunting challenges. He values teamwork but possesses the self-reliance to work autonomously, making him a dependable asset in high-stakes environments. His innovation score is a testament to his out-of-the-box thinking. He is passionate about mentoring young engineers and cultivating a culture of continuous improvement within the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Stefan is a lean man of average height with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a multi-tool, even to meetings.
Has a habit of sketching complex diagrams on napkins during lunch.
Insists on meticulously organizing his workspace every morning.
